3532-4928-5078-8346.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3220-4279-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-4279-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-5921-5970-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4689-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4689-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4881-6909-6974-7040.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-6974-7040.easyPrerequisites: Psychic Paper is attached to Carnage and has "Elemental" chosen
4881-6909-6974-7040.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost X or more life this turn.
6495-6972-7230.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7230.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2111-2292-3545.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

824-2728-2921-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-2921-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-2921-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

5256-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2-2060-7889.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5901-7750.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
3532-5078-5901-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4186-4384-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-5789.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1687-3967-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-3967-5972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2511-3817-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4772-5086-5183-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4772-5086-5183-5231-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1274-3129-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-3129-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

3459-4289-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3490-4659-5572-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
3490-4659-5572-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-3263-3967-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with the persist creature

1856-6249-6797--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1856-6249-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and the ability granted to it by Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the trigger from the ability granted by Doom Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1496-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
1496-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-4716.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-2793-3743-5089-5436.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2557-2793-3743-5089-5436.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2-4365-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1636-4862-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-4862-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath's second ability triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath's first ability triggers, creating a 5/5 Elemental creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1140-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites:
Staff of Titania attached to any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature except the creature that has Staff of Titania attached that has power 1 or greater and that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1140-3259-4478.description:
Declare the creatures with Staff of Titania and Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Staff of Titania triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Forest Dryad token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

430-2567-4768.notablePrerequisites:
Each opponent has no more than ninety-one cards in their library.
You control at least nine lands.
You have not created a token this turn.
430-2567-4768.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, it and Altar of the Brood triggers.
Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar for each land you control due to Esik.
Each Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, triggering themselves and triggering Altar of the Brood once for each token.
Resolve all Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill that many cards.
Resolve the first Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
When the Plants enter the battlefield, Altar of the Brood triggers that many times, causing each opponent to mill that many cards.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining Avenger of Zendikar trigger.

1339-2089-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2089-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2907-3147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-573-1993.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-573-1993.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.
